name: W Guangzhou
positioning: A W hotel in Guangzhou's Pearl River New Town, steps from the Metro and Guangzhou East Railway Station, with an indoor heated infinity pool and AWAY Spa
best_for: City travelers who want easy Metro and rail access in Pearl River New Town
Guests who value club-level lounge access and a heated indoor pool

facts.text: W Guangzhou is in the Pearl River New Town district.
The FIT gym has personal training, city views and 24-hour access.
Every room has a signature W bed.
The suites include a Presidential Suite.
The Kitchen Table serves international dishes, with a buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner and an all-day a la carte menu.
WOOBAR is part of the Living Room, with a casual residential setting.
Up to two pets are allowed per room.

highlights.text: The WET pool is an indoor, heated infinity pool.
The hotel is steps from ancient sites, the Metro and Guangzhou East Railway Station.
AWAY Spa offers detoxing, de-stressing and beautifying treatments.
Club-level rooms come with W Lounge amenities, including food and drinks.
Rooms and suites are accented by vivid color.

considerations.text: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, the closest airport, is about 37 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the modern design may not appeal to guests with traditional tastes.
